Pune, Maharashtra
AI/ML Engineer focused on production GenAI systems and retrieval-augmented applications. Notice period: 90 days.

AI Engineer, UrbanPantry — Feb 2025 - Present
Leading development of a production Generative AI service to power conversational recipe and meal-planning assistant used by mobile and web customers. Built Python microservices that orchestrate prompts and retrieval, integrated AWS Bedrock models for response generation, and implemented RAG pipelines to fetch personalized content from product and recipe catalogs. Engineered embedding workflows and vector search to surface contextually relevant items, optimized latency and cost by batching calls to Amazon Bedrock and caching high-frequency prompts. Collaborated with backend and analytics teams to store session metadata in DynamoDB and instrumented performance tracking in Confluence/Git workflows.

ML Engineer - GenAI, Medisure — Feb 2023 - Jan 2025
Implemented RAG-based clinical knowledge assistant to surface relevant policy and medical guideline excerpts for support agents. Developed Python data pipelines to preprocess documents, generate embeddings, and index into Vector Databases for fast retrieval. Integrated AWS Bedrock APIs to produce natural-language responses while using hybrid retrieval strategies to ensure factual grounding. Deployed services with CI/CD using Git on Linux servers, and designed DynamoDB schemas for session and user state. Documented designs and runbooks in Confluence and tuned retrieval and prompt templates to improve answer relevance metrics.

Skills:
Python, GenAI, LLMs, AWS Bedrock, RAG, Vector Databases, DynamoDB, Git, Linux, Confluence

Education:
MBA (Marketing), IIM Indore
